expectations.text: Shows a story map with at least 2 distinct journeys, each broken into steps, before any BDD content is written
expectations.evidence: map.md has 3 journeys (Submit an expense, Review an expense, Pay out an expense), each with 2 steps, written before the Gherkin was produced.

expectations.text: Stories are organized under specific steps, not a flat ungrouped list
expectations.evidence: Each of the 6 steps in map.md has its own list of stories (e.g. 'Decide on a request' holds Approve/Reject/Approve with comment/Escalate).

expectations.text: A walking-skeleton slice is explicitly marked and is a strict subset of all stories, not all stories marked in-scope
expectations.evidence: 8 of 19 stories marked with the slice marker in map.md; issues.md confirms 8 'yes' / 11 'no' in the In slice column.

expectations.text: Every slice-marked story has a Gherkin Feature/Scenario/Given/When/Then block
expectations.evidence: Live-checked issue #18 ('Approve a request') body: contains 'Feature: Approve a request' with 3 Scenarios, each with Given/When/Then/And lines, including edge cases (can't approve own request, already-decided request).

expectations.text: A parent GitHub issue labeled 'story-map' exists with a body reflecting the journeys/steps/stories shown in chat
expectations.evidence: Live-checked issue #5: title 'Story Map: Expense reimbursement tool', label 'story-map'.

expectations.text: One child GitHub issue per story exists, labeled 'story', each linked to the parent
expectations.evidence: Live-checked: gh api .../issues/5/sub_issues returns exactly the 19 child numbers listed in issues.md (6,7,8,9,10,11,12,13,15,18,21,25,28,31,35,41,46,52,57).

expectations.text: Child issues for sliced stories contain the Gherkin spec in their body; non-sliced stories don't have fabricated Gherkin
expectations.evidence: Issue #18 (sliced) has full Gherkin; issue #7 (not sliced, 'Attach receipt image or PDF') body reads 'Not yet in the walking-skeleton slice. Plain story card pending a future pass.' with no fabricated scenarios.

uncertainties: Treated the proposed map as provisionally approved instead of getting real chat sign-off, since no human was available in this non-interactive run
Labeled assumptions: single-level manager approval, finance pays outside the tool, single currency, optional receipts
needs_review: Spec choices flagged for a human to confirm: manager can't approve own request, rejection requires a reason, only finance sees the payout queue
